t: The $(item)Pneumatic Dynamo/$ converts $(l:base_concepts/pressure)compressed air/$ into $(thing)Forge Energy/$, which is compatible with $(thing)Redstone Flux/$ and other mods' energy systems. It produces 40 FE/tick by default, but can be upgraded with $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)Speed Upgrades/$. The FE output rate of the $(item)Flux Compressor/$ is twice the amount of the current FE production; 80 FE/tick by default, but can be increased via Speed Upgrades.

$(item)气动能源炉/$可将$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压缩空气/$转化为$(thing)Forge能量/$，并与$(thing)红石通量/$及其他模组的能源系统兼容。默认产出为 40 FE/tick，但可通过$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)速度升级/$进行提升。$(item)通量压缩机/$的 FE 输出速率为当前 FE 产量的两倍；默认是 80 FE/tick，但也可以通过速度升级进一步提高。

An important factor that influences efficiency is the Dynamo's $(l:base_concepts/heat)temperature/$. The Dynamo needs to be $(thing)cooled/$, or its efficiency will drop as the temperature rises, up to the point where no air is generated at all.
影响效率的一个重要因素是发电机的$(l:base_concepts/heat)温度/$。发电机需要被$(thing)冷却/$，否则随着温度升高，其效率会下降，甚至最终完全无法产生空气。
